title: Mosali ya Mayele oyo ebombami
intro: Na tapisserie monene ya masolo ya Coran, etelemi figure enigmatique, mosali ya Allah gracieux na boyebi ya bonzambe mpe ngolu. Moto oyo ya kobombama akatisaki banzela elongo na moko ya basakoli minene, ememaki na mobembo oyo etondaki na misala ya kobulunganisa oyo ezalaki kotya ntembe na ndelo ya bososoli ya bato. Mosala moko na moko, atako emonanaki lokola ete ezali sembo te, ebombaki mateya ya mozindo na ntina ya nsuka, motema molai, mpe bwanya oyo emonanaki te nsima ya mobeko ya Nzambe. Nani azali moto oyo ya elili, mpe bosolo nini bamonisaki?
clues: Nazalaki mosali ya Allah, aponami mpo na boyebi mpe ngolu ya sipesiale.
Profeta moko monene alukaki koyekola epai na ngai, mpe nandimaki na nse ya makambo ya makasi.
Na boumeli ya likita na biso, nasalaki makambo misato oyo emonanaki lokola ete ezali sembo te mpo na moninga na ngai.
Nabebisaki masuwa moko ya babola, nzokande ezalaki mawa oyo ebombamaki.
Nabomaki bomoi ya elenge mobali moko, atako emonanaki lokola motema mabe, ezalaki mpo na kobikisa baboti na ye mawa.
Natongaki lisusu efelo moko na engumba moko oyo ezalaki koboya biso koyamba bapaya, mpe namonisaki eloko moko ya motuya oyo ezalaki na nse na yango.

identity.label: Nazali Nani?
options: Mokonzi oyo azalaki koswana na Ibrahim

trial.label: Momekano/Evenement
options: Kokutana na Prophète Musa na bokutani ya ba mer mibale
Kotonga epekiseli mpo na kobundisa Goge mpe Magoge
trial.answer: Kokutana na Prophète Musa na bokutani ya ba mer mibale

outcome.label: Resultat
options: Alimbolaki mayele ya bonzambe oyo ezalaki nsima ya misala na ye ya kobulunganisa mpe akabwanaki na Musa
Bapesaki ye bosakoli nsima ya mobembo
Masuwa yango ebebisamaki na mopɛpɛ makasi
Mwana mobali yango azongaki na bomoi
Atongaki mosquée na engumba oyo ezalaki na bato te
outcome.answer: Alimbolaki mayele ya bonzambe oyo ezalaki nsima ya misala na ye ya kobulunganisa mpe akabwanaki na Musa

arabic: فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًۭا مِّنْ عِبَادِنَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَـٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلْمًۭا
verse: And they found a servant from among Our servants [i.e., al-Khiḍr] to whom We had given mercy from Us and had taught him from Us a [certain] knowledge. (18:65)
